verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (the GDHQ portal, the self-service Contract Generator, the D&O Questionnaire Portal and Catalyze), so API parity with those UIs is a fair axis. The evidence describes only web and UI access. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and no public API is documented.
